text_block_list.text:
Having been asked to keep her company 
during dance lessons, I was watching 
Sirius Symboli dance.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Right here—!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Don't look at me like a deer in 
headlights. We're doing it over again.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I've got the dance down. All that's left 
is... a performance that drives them wild.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Once I get my hands on that, the star 
named Sirius will burn even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But... if you're like this as her pet dog, 
we're not getting anywhere.

She seems eager to come up with a 
performance that gets the audience even 
more hyped. If that's the caseâ
choice_data_list:
Why not ask someone who's good at hyping 
people up for some tips?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh? For instance?
choice_data_list:
Maybe someone who's familiar with current 
trends would be best.

text_block_list.text:
Trends are truly the passion of the 
people. And when it comes to girls who 
know all about them—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: A concert performanceee??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, there's no real trick to it! Vibes! 
Hype! Check it! That's it☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, maybe we'll get it once we start 
dancing~!? Let's hype it up~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, trends are all about intuition, 
right? Why don't we just try dancing 
together for now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Why not upload it to UmaTok while you're 
at it and see how people react?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Fine. If I'm doing this, I'm going 
all out.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyâ Let's get hype~ Put'cha hands up!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wait... For real? The views are going 
completely insane.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't Uma-tter trending with her? 
"Sirius", "So cool", "Hype First-Magnitude 
Star"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If being cool is what wins people over, 
wouldn't that make it the right answer for 
you, Sirius-san?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... No matter what it is, it's always 
worth a try.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, they're asking, 'Will there be a 
part 2?~' Care to answer for the camera~? 
Go ahead?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh? Don't get cocky, idiot.
This video also went quite viral.

"When it comes to concerts, it's all about 
catching the groove. And as for the girls 
who know all about that—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, so bored. Wish somethin' fun would 
happen~.
choice_data_list:
This is out of the blue, but do something 
funny!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty~ Then I guess I'll show off a 
quick party trick~...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, as if I wouldーー!? I just said I 
was looking for something fun to do, and 
nearly got dragged into being the 
entertainment! Scary stuff!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
? ...Tama, isn't it time for your party 
trick yet?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Oguri, what I just did is called a 
straight-man routine, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Bwah! Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“......You expect me to do this? Are you 
mocking me?”
choice_data_list: I-It might be... good reference, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
A performance that gets the audience 
involved. Thinking of it that way, it's 
not a bad angle at all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm. The one doing the quick gag was 
Sirius, was it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Aah?! I ain't doing that!

All in all, the live performance skills 
were polished to perfection!
